global_rules.text: Lead with the conclusion and keep routine progress/output concise.
Do the requested work; do not stop at plans, research, or promises when execution is possible.
Continue reversible, low-impact next steps without asking for confirmation when context already authorizes them.
Re-read current source, data, repository, or production state instead of trusting stale prior reports.
Prefer current primary/official sources and preserve source identity, dates, and provenance.
Use real observed data where the task requires factual or production evidence; never present dummy data as completion.
Prefer one canonical source of truth and one-way derivation into views, dashboards, or reports.
A required gate is complete only when it has concrete evidence.
Never mark a check PASS when it did not actually run or was not directly verified.
Verify the requested end state and clean up temporary or superseded work before reporting completion.

gates.text: Inspect the relevant current state.
Perform the requested work, not only analysis.
Verify the resulting state or artifact.
Report what was learned, changed, and what remains.

repo.description: GitHub/software work from current state through verified integration.

gates.text: Inspect current main, relevant issues/PRs, and existing implementation before changing anything.
Implement the smallest change that satisfies the requested contract.
Run meaningful repository checks derived from the actual toolchain.
Create or update the single canonical PR/workline when a PR workflow is used.
Verify checks for the exact head SHA when CI exists; a different SHA does not count.
Merge when the requested contract is proven and repository rules allow it.
Read back main or the deployed state after integration.
Remove superseded branches/artifacts and confirm no duplicate workline remains.

research_data.description: Research/data collection with provenance and canonicalization.

gates.text: Define the concrete universe, fields, dates, and completeness target.
Collect current primary/official evidence before secondary summaries where feasible.
Preserve raw observations with source URL/identity, observed date, and units.
Normalize identities, units, dates, duplicates, NULL semantics, and canonical keys.
Quantify missing, stale, duplicate, or unverified records against the target universe.
Write the verified result to the canonical store or requested output and preserve provenance.

investment.description: Investment research built on point-in-time evidence, scenarios, and explicit risk.

gates.text: Fix the valuation/analysis date and ensure evidence was available by that time.
Collect primary filings/IR and distinguish reported facts from derived metrics and forecasts.
Connect operational drivers such as CapEx/capacity/backlog to revenue, profit, EPS, or FCF assumptions.
State scenario assumptions and compare them with observed/current consensus where relevant.
Record downside cases, uncertainty, and what evidence would falsify the thesis.
Persist the decision inputs and provenance in the canonical investment store.

image.description: Image-generation workflow with deliberate simplification and visual review.

gates.text: Fix subject, composition, intended use, and any factual constraints.
Reduce background clutter, palette/tone count, tiny detail, glow, and unnecessary text unless requested.
Generate the requested image/artifact.
Review the actual render for composition, brush texture, artifacts, and requested simplification.
